items.title: Intel Climbs 4%, AMD Rises 3%, NVIDIA Ticks Up as Chip Stocks Shrug Off Rising Rate Hike Odds
items.summary: A blowout jobs report pushed September rate hike odds past 60%, which should have hammered high-multiple chip stocks. Instead, the semiconductor complex ran straight into the headwind and left the rest of tech behind.

items.title: Intel Witnesses an Uptrend in Estimate Revisions: Is it Worth Buying?
items.summary: INTC's estimate revisions point higher as AI demand, manufacturing gains and expanding custom silicon offset supply and competition risks.

items.title: QCOM Showered Owners With Cash. The Stock Still Lagged The Market
items.summary: The chipmaker showered its owners with cash while the stock price went nowhere fast, raising a sharp question about what all that money actually bought.

items.title: SMCI Rises 29% Year to Date: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer gains 29% YTD as record backlog, AI partnerships and rising shipments fuel growth, while improving margins add to its appeal.

items.title: Silicon Motion Surges 186% in Past Year: Reason to Buy the Stock?
items.summary: SIMO's 186.1% surge reflects strength in NAND controllers, expanding customer ties, product innovation and growth across AI, cloud and autos.

items.title: Cathie Wood Just Bought 705,102 Shares of a Rocket Company 50 Times Smaller Than SpaceX
items.summary: ARK Invest just loaded up on a rocket company trading at a fraction of SpaceX's valuation, and the timing raises a pointed question about whether the recent selloff is a warning sign or a once-in-a-cycle entry point.

items.title: Here’s the Real Reason Nvidia Is Buying Hugging Face
items.summary: Nvidia stock rose after it announced a $12.9 billion deal for Hugging Face. This is what's behind the move.

items.title: Cathie Wood Cuts AMD and Puts $53 Million Into Nvidia
items.summary: ARK Invest shifted its semiconductor exposure after Nvidia's latest earnings, selling about $72.8 million of AMD while adding to Nvidia.
